finalText:
Found it. `src/core/settings.js` had `maxRetries: retries` — `retries` isn't defined anywhere, it should read from `env.retries`. That threw and killed the build every time, and it was hiding under all the compile noise.

Fixed that one line, and the build now finishes clean: exit 0, 3 warnings, 0 errors.

The 3 warnings that remain are just notices, not blockers: a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call in `src/legacy/adapter.js`, an unused export `formatLegacyDate` in `src/utils/format.js`, and a circular import between `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js`. Worth cleaning up sometime, but they don't stop the build.
